title: The Confidence view moves into the Navigator, with four presets
items: The Confidence view now has its own app in the Navigator, in place of the HUD's Confidence chip, its arrow and its checkbox menu. Four presets are one tap each: Normal, By grade, Attested only and X-ray.

By grade is the view you know: Attested gold, Inferred silver, Reconstructed bronze. Attested only shows just the parts somebody wrote down. X-ray keeps Attested solid, shows Inferred at half strength and ghosts Reconstructed, so you can see through it.
Each grade has a row with its own switch and a count of how many buildings stand at that grade. A readout underneath shows how many grades are on, how many buildings are showing and the frame rate.
C still toggles By grade. The Confidence view icon glows while the view is on, and your choice is kept for your next visit.
In X-ray, fences, yards and other small furniture are drawn see-through with a fine dither instead of a second pass, so the town stays quick.
